confirmed_task:
Open Project Gutenberg eBook 1342, Pride and Prejudice. Report the author, Release Date, Last Update, language, and whether EPUB3, Plain Text (accessible), and Download HTML (zip) are available.

Stopping condition: Stop after the four metadata fields and availability of all three named formats have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use the Release Date and Last Update labels on the Project Gutenberg page; do not substitute the novel's original publication date.
- Check only the three specifically named format labels.
- Do not download any ebook file.
- Preserve displayed dates and format labels exactly.

items.criterion: Use the correct Project Gutenberg eBook page (eBook #1342, Pride and Prejudice)
items.description: Evaluate whether the agent consulted the Project Gutenberg page for eBook 1342 (Pride and Prejudice) to obtain metadata and format availability. Full credit if the agent clearly uses/targets https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/1342 (or an equivalent Gutenberg page for ebook 1342) OR if it attempts to access it but is blocked (e.g., CAPTCHA, 403, site down) and clearly states the blocker. Partial credit if the agent uses a different Gutenberg mirror/page while clearly indicating it is for eBook 1342. No credit if the agent uses a non-Gutenberg source or the wrong ebook number/title without justification.

Report the author as displayed on the Project Gutenberg eBook 1342 page. Full credit for correctly capturing the author name. If the Gutenberg page cannot be accessed or the Author field cannot be viewed due to external factors (CAPTCHA, outage, rendering failure), award full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot verify the author from the page and states the access issue encountered. Partial credit if the author is correct but formatting deviates from the page (e.g., missing punctuation) or is ambiguous. No credit if the author is incorrect (not matching the page) or omitted without explaining an access blocker.

items.criterion: Report the Release Date (using the page label and exact displayed date)
items.description: Report the 'Release Date' exactly as labeled and displayed on the Project Gutenberg page (not the novel's historical publication date). Full credit for providing the exact displayed Release Date text/date. If the Gutenberg page cannot be accessed or the Release Date label/value cannot be viewed due to external factors, award full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot verify the Release Date from the page and states the access issue encountered. Partial credit if the agent provides the correct date but alters the label or formatting (e.g., rephrases or normalizes the date). No credit if the agent substitutes an original publication date, provides an unverified/incorrect date, or omits it without explaining an access blocker.

items.criterion: Report the Last Update (using the page label and exact displayed date)
items.description: Report the 'Last Update' exactly as labeled and displayed on the Project Gutenberg page. Full credit for providing the exact displayed Last Update text/date. If the Gutenberg page cannot be accessed or the Last Update label/value cannot be viewed due to external factors, award full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot verify the Last Update from the page and states the access issue encountered. Partial credit if the agent provides the correct date but changes formatting or label text. No credit if omitted or incorrect without explaining an access blocker.

Report the language as shown on the Project Gutenberg page. Full credit for correctly stating the language value. If the Gutenberg page cannot be accessed or the Language field cannot be viewed due to external factors, award full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot verify the Language from the page and states the access issue encountered. Partial credit if language is correct but not clearly tied to the page (e.g., inferred without stating it was from the Gutenberg page). No credit if incorrect or missing without explaining an access blocker.

items.criterion: Check availability of format label: EPUB3
items.description: Determine whether the specific format label 'EPUB3' is available on the Project Gutenberg page. Full credit if the agent explicitly records availability (yes/no) for the exact label 'EPUB3' based on the page. If the Gutenberg page cannot be accessed or the format list cannot be viewed due to external factors, award full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot verify whether 'EPUB3' is available and states the access issue encountered. Partial credit if the agent checks EPUB generally but does not confirm the exact 'EPUB3' label. No credit if the agent reports on other formats instead or omits EPUB3 availability without explaining an access blocker.

items.criterion: Check availability of format label: Plain Text (accessible)
items.description: Determine whether the specific format label 'Plain Text (accessible)' is available on the Project Gutenberg page. Full credit if the agent explicitly records availability (yes/no) for the exact label 'Plain Text (accessible)' based on the page. If the Gutenberg page cannot be accessed or the format list cannot be viewed due to external factors, award full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot verify whether 'Plain Text (accessible)' is available and states the access issue encountered. Partial credit if the agent reports plain text availability without confirming the exact label including '(accessible)'. No credit if omitted or if the agent checks different text formats/labels, unless an access blocker is clearly reported.

items.criterion: Check availability of format label: Download HTML (zip)
items.description: Determine whether the specific format label 'Download HTML (zip)' is available on the Project Gutenberg page. Full credit if the agent explicitly records availability (yes/no) for the exact label 'Download HTML (zip)' based on the page. If the Gutenberg page cannot be accessed or the format list cannot be viewed due to external factors, award full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot verify whether 'Download HTML (zip)' is available and states the access issue encountered. Partial credit if the agent reports HTML availability without confirming the '(zip)' label. No credit if omitted or if the agent reports other HTML variants only, unless an access blocker is clearly reported.

items.criterion: Respect task constraints and stopping condition
items.description: Assess compliance with explicit constraints: (1) do not download any ebook file; (2) use the Release Date and Last Update labels on the Gutenberg page (no substitution with original publication date); (3) check only the three specifically named format labels; (4) stop after recording the four metadata fields (author, Release Date, Last Update, language) and availability of all three named formats. Full credit if all constraints are followed. Do not penalize an agent for missing metadata/format determinations if it clearly explains that access to the Gutenberg page (or the relevant fields) was blocked or unavailable; do penalize for actual violations like downloading files, substituting dates, or adding extra unrelated formats/fields when the page is accessible.
